dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - chemical exposure at PSV-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 23 May 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
